Name: Selectable Buffs
Author: FawazT
Description:
[size=6][b]How does it work?[/b][/size]
Once the mod is installed, the standard "random" logic of the statues is replaced with a user-controlled selection process:
[list]
[*][b]Interaction:[/b] Approach the [b]Statue of Blessings[/b] or the [b]Statue of the Dwarf King[/b] as you normally would.[/*]
[*][b]The Menu:[/b] Upon interacting, instead of receiving an immediate random effect, a clear selection menu will appear on your screen.[/*]
[*][b]Selection:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Statue of Blessings:[/b] You can choose from the full list of daily blessings (such as the Blessing of the Butterfly, etc).[/*]
[*][b]Statue of the Dwarf King:[/b] You are no longer restricted to a random pair of options. You can now browse and select any power from the entire pool.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Activation:[/b] Once selected, the blessing or power is applied to your character immediately, and the statue is "spent" for the day, just like in the vanilla game.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=6]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url].[/*]
[*]Download focustense's [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]StardewUI[/url][/b] mod.[/*]
[*]Download Selectable Buffs.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]Supports keyboard, mouse, and controller inputs for the selection menu, thanks to [b]StardewUI[/b].[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=6][b]Special Thanks[/b][/size]
This mod was made possible by a commission from someone who prefers to remain anonymous. Thank you for your support.
